<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 179.0946 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral molecular mass of ≈178.087 Da. A formula of C₁₁H₁₄O₂ matches this mass (exact mass 178.0994 Da) and the observed ~11 % M+1 isotopic intensity, consistent with the presence of ~11 carbons. Therefore the molecular formula is C11H14O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H14O2</final_answer>
